_comment: Awin feeds used by Pets Gear World (ZGW). advertiserId and feedIds as in the Awin archive folders (AWIN_<advertiserId>_<feedId>.csv.gz). Add a retailer only after Awin has approved the programme. First version (1 Nov 2026, after the pets feed scan): Joybuy UK (the main source, about 960 pet products), Plusshop UK and Bazta UK (the same catalogue: at the same price only the Plusshop card stays, tools/cleanup-rules/twin-price.mjs) and Coes (Barbour Dog). VEVOR is the Dutch feed in euros (lessons L79). Red Gorilla's Awin feed stopped in May 2026 (stale prices): off until it sends a fresh feed. Aquatics Shop UK (Fishcave Aquatics) approved 2 Nov 2026: aquarium and pond products only, never its live fish ("aquatics": true, lessons L90). zooplus, Viovet and Omlet: applied 2 Nov 2026.
